capacity_gross_kwh.notes: Estimated: EC40 is the C40 Recharge renamed for 2025 and shares the CMA platform, pack and charger with the same-year EX40 (and the XC40/C40 pair before); the EX40 value was read on the cited page. KBB: 82 kWh battery on the 2026 EX40; US 2025 pricing release (via InsideEVs) puts the Twin on 82 kWh; the single motor has been on the 82 kWh pack since 2024.

EV Database (European 82 kWh pack, 108s1p prismatic NMC): 79.0 kWh usable; Volvo UK press (search excerpt) calls the pack 82/79 kWh nominal/usable. 2026 Twin Motor AWD: KBB lists 82 kWh; EV Database MY26 Twin 82/79. OpenEV shows 78/69 kWh at 150 kW, which conflicts and looks stale.
